title: Henderson as a leader; overconfidence and John Hammond
summary: Thomas says Henderson was strict about the music but too sure of himself, and the band's momentum was lost when John Hammond's connection with Benny Goodman took over.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, this thing you're saying about Smack being strict about music, how was he as a sort of a leader as a man? I mean I've always thought that they rather suggested that he was too easy going.

Well, that could be a point but, you know, when you do a lot of things, you've got to have somebody to take your care of other things. If you sit here in your home and you're write for 12 hours a night, somebody has got to take care of the other side of it. That's where he was -- very strict about his music. Not strict to the point of demanding ...
Well, I mean what if you come late, what happens?
I never came late so I don't know.
Well, that's what they used to say that sometimes only half the band would show up and that sort of thing.
Well, it happens. It happened that way.
But, he could sort of ride with it?

Yes, he did. And I think it happened with him, it was around the time I met a young lady, young wife out there, you know. I think it happened with him, you know, sometimes you can get too sure. I think it happens in every man's life, you can get too sure. He had a come back, you know. I think he ... with the idea too much and John Hammond had bought Benny by, when we were rehearsing. ... Benny Goodman, you know. And he started arranging with Benny. Benny Goodman was a tremendous musician. And John Hammond's a tremendous person but I think he relaxed with the idea too much. Before you know it, the thing had gotten out of hand and he lost control of his whole musical idea which he had worked for. See what I mean? You want to stop now?
You were saying that Smack relaxed but did not have a manager and was probably sort of a little over confident.
Don't use those big words with me, now over confident. Use some English words with me.
I mean do you think that Smack felt too sure of ...
I do really and truly, Stan.
I mean Smack after all had been at the top for a longer than anybody at this time, for 12 years.
Yes, he did. I felt he felt a little too confident.
Yeah, well that's what it really what it was (2).
